description: A query observes one seed while an ordinary repetition shares its alternatives. The same text rule also occurs inside an observed seed.
grammar:
%ambiguity-resolution greedy
%rule text $x(seed) {unit}
%conditions matches(without-elision($x), seed)
%rule seed 'x' [+T] | '(' text ')'
%rule unit 'a' [+U] | 'a' [+V]
